## Decision

Vault prohibits derived projections (MAP.md, open-items/, TRACE.html) because they regenerate from a corpus and can silently disagree with it. Machine-written authoritative files (journal/, decisions/, tickets/) cannot drift and are permitted.

## Rationale

A file can only deviate from reality if something else is its authoritative source. The regenerated class has a source and therefore can go stale; the authoritative class IS the source and therefore cannot. This is the governing principle for tickets 29-33, absorbed from the abandoned tickets-only-vault motive. That motive was planned on a false premise (that .groundwork/journal/*.jsonl is the authoritative store); gw journal show/compile actually reads decisions/*.md in the motive dir.
